title: The Lantern Keeper
plot: A reclusive lighthouse keeper on a storm-battered island finds letters washing ashore that seem to predict shipwrecks before they happen. As he races to warn passing vessels, he uncovers a decades-old crime buried in the village's history.

title: Orbit of Ash
plot: Two engineers aboard a failing space station must decide who returns to Earth when the last escape capsule can only carry one. Paranoia grows as station logs reveal that one of them sabotaged the reactor.

title: Paper Crowns
plot: A failed stage actress returns to her hometown to run her late father's struggling children's theatre. Her chaotic production of a royal fairy tale slowly reunites a fractured family and a skeptical town.

title: Quiet Frequency
plot: A radio astronomer detects a repeating signal that only appears when her deaf daughter is in the observatory. The search for its source leads to a government cover-up and a question about how humans perceive the universe.

title: Salt and Iron
plot: In a nineteenth-century mining town, a blacksmith leads a revolt against the company that owns every building, store and job. A brutal strike turns into a siege as the company hires mercenaries to break the workers.

title: Neon Tide
plot: A courier in a flooded megacity smuggles memory drives between rival syndicates. When she accidentally views the memories she carries, she learns the city's floodwalls are being deliberately weakened.

title: The Last Orchard
plot: Two estranged sisters inherit a dying apple orchard and must harvest one final season before the land is sold. Long-held resentments surface as they discover their mother's secret second life.

title: Glass Harbor
plot: An insurance investigator examining a string of yacht fires in a wealthy harbor town uncovers a pact among old money families. Each fire erases evidence of a smuggling ring that has run for generations.

title: Clockwork Saints
plot: A thief steals a mechanical relic from a cathedral and discovers it is a living automaton that remembers the city's founding. Hunted by zealots, the pair travel through underground workshops to restore its missing heart.

title: Winter Algorithm
plot: A grieving programmer trains an AI on her late husband's messages to talk to him again. The model begins revealing things he never told her, forcing her to question whether it is remembering or inventing.

title: Red Valley Run
plot: A disgraced rally driver agrees to race across a desert valley to deliver medicine to a cut-off village. Bandits, sandstorms and a rival team turn the journey into a fight for survival.

title: Small Hours
plot: Two night-shift workers, a baker and a hospital janitor, keep crossing paths at the same all-night bus stop. Their awkward conversations slowly become the best part of both their lives.

title: Hollow Crown of Vey
plot: A reluctant heir inherits a kingdom whose crown drains the memories of whoever wears it. She must choose between ruling as a stranger to herself or letting a tyrant take the throne.

title: Undertow
plot: A coastal police detective investigates the drowning of a teenager and suspects it was not an accident. The trail leads to his own brother and a fishing fleet hiding illegal catches.

title: Starlight Diner
plot: A roadside diner in the desert becomes a regular stop for stranded aliens who just want good pie. The owner tries to keep the secret while a nosy health inspector keeps showing up.

title: Ferryman
plot: A night ferry operator realizes his passengers are recently deceased souls who cannot remember how they died. Helping one young woman recover her memory exposes a murder in the living world.
